    THE IDEA BEHIND THE WALK

    More trees.
    Less exposed walking.

    CoolPath compares the shortest mapped walking route with a route that favours estimated tree canopy, using A* pathfinding.

    What the numbers mean

    “Canopy estimate” is a model based on tree inventory canopy widths overlapping a 10 m corridor around path segments. This is an area-overlap proxy, not the fraction of your walking line in shade. It is not a guarantee of shade at a particular time, or a measurement of temperature. Tree inventories can miss trees, especially on private land and campus.

    The route cost is distance × (1 + preference × uncovered fraction). Walking times assume 4.8 km/h and exclude waits, slopes and individual mobility needs. Steps, barriers and access may not be fully recorded. This is not step-free or wheelchair routing.

    A bounded local pilot

    Loading data details…

    Your selected points are sent to the local FastAPI backend, which calculates routes using NetworkX and PostGIS data. Location is requested only when you choose “Use my location”; it is not stored by this app. Map tiles load from OpenStreetMap, which receives normal browser request information.
